data.objetivo_inversion: To provide long term capital growth through exposure to European companies, by direct investments in securities of such companies and through the use of derivatives. Investment Approach: Uses a bottom-up stock selection process. Uses the full breadth of the eligible equity investment universe through a combination of fundamental research insights and quantitative analysis. Uses an active extension approach, buying securities considered attractive and selling short securities considered less attractive to improve potential returns without increasing the overall net exposure to the market. Share Class Benchmark: MSCI Europe Index (Total Return Net). SFDR Classification: Article 8.
